The test image shows corn plants in a field at an early vegetative stage. Key observations:
- Variable plant heights — some plants noticeably shorter/more stunted than others
- Leaves appear mostly green but with some possible pale/yellowish coloring on certain plants
- No obvious leaf lesions, pustules, or spots visible
- Internode spacing appears compressed on shorter plants

Top candidates based on these symptoms:
- **Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma**: stunted plants, short internodes
- **Downy_mildew**: stunting, pale yellowing/striping
- **Stewarts_wilt**: pale green streaks, systemic wilting
- **Maize_dwarf_mosaic_virus**: mosaic/yellowing, stunting

Let me view reference images for these candidates:
Corn Stunt reference shows heavily reddish/brown dried plants — doesn't match. Downy mildew reference shows young corn seedlings similar to test image. Let me check more candidates:
Stewart's wilt shows very small seedlings with pale patches. Maize dwarf mosaic shows distinct mosaic/yellowing patterns not matching. Let me look at two more candidates closely:

Crazy_top shows bushy tassels/proliferations — not matching. Maize_streak_virus shows distinct yellow streaking — not clearly visible in test image.

The test image most closely resembles the **Downy_mildew** reference (young corn plants with variable heights, stunting, similar field context). Let me confirm with one more look:

**Maize_chlorotic_dwarf_virus** reference shows a striking similarity: corn plants at V5-V7 stage with variable heights, some shorter/stunted, field setting very similar to the test image. It also shows vein banding on close-up leaf view (bottom right).

## Analysis Summary

**Test image features:**
- Corn plants at ~V5-V7 vegetative stage
- Variable plant heights — some clearly shorter/more stunted than neighbors
- Leaves appear mostly green, possibly with slight pale/lighter coloring on some
- No obvious spots, lesions, rust pustules, or pronounced streaking
- Similar bare-soil field setting

**Reference comparison:**
| Disease | Match |
|---------|-------|
| Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma | ❌ — plants severely reddish/brown, very different |
| Downy_mildew | ✓ — young plants, variable heights, similar field — but reference plants much smaller (V1-V3) |
| Stewarts_wilt | ⚠ — seedling wilt phase but reference shows V1-V2 tiny seedlings only |
| Maize_dwarf_mosaic_virus | ❌ — distinct mosaic/yellow patches clearly visible |
| Maize_chlorotic_dwarf_virus | ✓ — field view matches best: V5-V7 plants, some shorter, vein banding possible |
| Crazy_top | ❌ — proliferating bushy tassel/tillers |
| Maize_streak_virus | ❌ — distinct yellow/white streaks clearly visible |

The test image most closely matches **Downy_mildew** — the reference images show a similar young-plant field setting with variable stunting and otherwise mostly green appearance, matching what early downy mildew looks like before heavy white striping develops.
